desc.p1: I'm a software developer with professional experience building modern web applications and taking products from idea to production. I enjoy solving real-world problems and building reliable, user-friendly systems using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and modern cloud technologies.
desc.p2: I'm the founder and full-stack engineer behind My Panel App — a live multi-tenant SaaS appointment-booking platform that I designed, built, and currently operate end-to-end. From database design and API architecture to deployment, authentication, and infrastructure, I own every layer of the product.
desc.p3: What excites me most is product ownership. I love debugging production issues, making architectural decisions, learning new technologies when the problem demands it, and shipping software that real businesses can use every day.

job_1.desc: Developed production-grade SPA and PWA applications for Insurtech products using React and TypeScript while collaborating closely with backend engineers and product teams.

res.1: - Built modern SPA and installable PWA applications with React and TypeScript.
res.2: - Developed and maintained reusable component libraries used across multiple products to improve consistency and delivery speed.
res.3: - Worked with backend developers and product managers to design, implement, and ship production features.

job_2.desc: Designed and built a live multi-tenant SaaS appointment-booking platform from scratch for service-based businesses. Responsible for architecture, development, infrastructure, deployment, and product decisions across the entire stack.

res.1: - Built the platform using Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB including data modeling, API design, and secure authentication.
res.2: - Migrated authentication to an HttpOnly refresh cookie architecture and resolved route-protection race conditions and production authentication issues.
res.3: - Implemented bilingual Persian/English support across the frontend and backend including RTL/LTR layouts, localized emails, PDF receipts, and language-aware middleware.
res.4: - Designed database-level protections against double-booked appointments using MongoDB compound unique indexes and configurable business scheduling.
res.5: - Deployed and operate the production stack across Vercel, Render, Cloudflare, MongoDB Atlas, and Supabase Storage.
res.6: - Integrated SMS notifications, OTP verification, and automated appointment reminders.

edu_0.desc: Currently pursuing my Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering while building and operating a production SaaS product.

edu_1.desc: Completed an intensive web development bootcamp focused on modern frontend and backend technologies including JavaScript, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, MySQL, and collaborative development practices using Git and GitHub.

edu_2.desc: Graduated from a selective high school that required passing a competitive entrance examination.
